domain_guidance.summary: This domain focuses heavily on cloud computing concepts, architectural principles, design considerations, and deployment models required for establishing secure cloud computing environments across various enterprise operational structures and organizational frameworks.

This domain covers data security in the cloud, including data discovery, data classification, encryption methods, tokenization, key management, and storage protection strategies for sensitive assets located within diverse computing architectures.

This domain addresses the security of cloud platforms and underlying infrastructure components used in cloud deployments, ensuring physical and logical protection for hardware, virtualization layers, and networking elements against unauthorized access.

This domain examines software security and application development practices within cloud computing environments, highlighting secure coding standards, vulnerability assessment, and effective application deployment life cycles to maintain integrity throughout operations.

This domain pertains to day-to-day security operations, monitoring activities, incident response procedures, configuration management, and infrastructure maintenance required to keep cloud environments resilient against emerging threats and operational disruptions.

This domain focuses on legal requirements, regulatory compliance frameworks, risk management methodologies, privacy issues, and audit processes related to cloud outsourcing and enterprise data governance strategies within modern regulatory landscapes.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Manage your time carefully across the 150 questions during the 180 minutes allowed, reading each question carefully and pacing yourself appropriately throughout the testing session.

faq.answer_text: The exam contains a total of 150 questions covering six distinct domains of cloud security knowledge designed to test professional competency and verify your real-world technical expertise.
faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?

faq.answer_text: The passing score for this certification exam is established at 700 out of 1000 points to prove your cloud security proficiency and readiness for professional responsibilities.
The exam has a maximum duration of 180 minutes to complete all questions within the allotted testing window while maintaining careful focus and proper time management.
The exam is administered and certified by ISC2 for experienced information security professionals working in cloud computing roles across various global industries and enterprises today.

editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the ISC2 CCSP Certified Cloud Security Professional exam with 150 questions, a passing score of 700, and domain coverage.

methodology.summary: This index was compiled using official ISC2 documentation and standard guidelines to provide factual exam preparation details, test specifications, and detailed domain breakdowns for candidates.

editorial.overview: The CCSP Certified Cloud Security Professional credential is administered by ISC2 and evaluates knowledge across multiple cloud security domains. It includes a total of 150 questions, provides a maximum testing duration of 180 minutes, and requires a passing score of 700 out of 1000 points to successfully achieve the credential for modern enterprise environments.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review official ISC2 exam guides and study the six domains systematically to master the material over the 180 minutes testing window. Focus on understanding cloud service and deployment models, data protection mechanisms, security operations, and compliance requirements before taking the certification test to achieve success.
editorial.who_should_take: System planners, program managers, enterprise technologists, and information security professionals who design, secure, implement, or manage cloud computing services, applications, and infrastructure environments across modern organizations.
